source.description:
## PROBLEM

Even with a working claim verifier (PR1), the auto-reconcile pipeline still ships whatever LLM output arrives — the verifier is advisory-only. The blast-radius fix requires the gate: reconcile.py must write to a candidate path FIRST, invoke the verifier, then act on the verdict. Only PASS and PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES may reach the canonical atomic_write. Same rule applies to the service-skills-sync specialist so local runs cannot bypass what CI enforces.

Research §2.7 rejects a naive 3-tier lattice (CONFLICT/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE/PASS→auto-merge) as too aggressive for the first rollout. The recommended 6-tier lattice (INVALID/CONFLICT/EVIDENCE_RACE/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_HIGH_RISK/PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES/PASS) treats PASS as 'open PR, no auto-merge' by default; auto-merge is a separate later decision (PR5).

Research §2.8 rejects LLM-panel majority as a gate arbiter and recommends deterministic-first + LLM critic ONLY on residuals the deterministic verifier returned UNKNOWN on. The critic sees only the residual claim + type + relevant diff + small evidence bundle + reason UNKNOWN was returned; its verdict is advisory.

## SUCCESS

- reconcile.py generates candidate to a temp path (worktree or /tmp), invokes the PR1 verifier CLI, receives the manifest, computes gate per §2.7 lattice, and ONLY on PASS/PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES calls atomic_write.
- Same entry point invoked from service-skills-sync specialist — no bypass path.
- INVALID / CONFLICT: no write, no PR; report emitted.
- EVIDENCE_RACE (source SHA changed mid-run): invalidate + retry the whole run.
- INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_HIGH_RISK: produce a draft PR clearly not-mergeable, or (local flow) refuse the write with an explicit override flag.
- PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES: normal PR, no auto-merge, advisories rendered in the PR description.
- PASS: normal PR, no auto-merge.
- Residual critic pass: for claims the deterministic verifier returned UNKNOWN on and where risk >= medium, an LLM critic call runs with a bounded evidence bundle; its verdict is stored as advisory in the manifest and rendered in the PR description. Never used as a gate arbiter.
- Verification report published as GHA artifact and check on every auto-reconcile PR; visible to human reviewers alongside the diff.

## SCOPE

- ~/dev/core/.claude/skills/service-skills/scripts/reconcile.py
  - New helper: run_verifier(candidate_path, current_path, territory, refs) → manifest
  - New helper: compute_gate(manifest) → GateVerdict enum
  - New helper: run_residual_critic(unknown_claims, evidence_bundles, provider_client) → advisory annotations
  - atomic_write is only called from the PASS/PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES branch
- ~/dev/specialists/config/specialists/service-skills-sync.specialist.json
  - task_template mandates invoking the same verifier entry point before any write
  - specialist may not use --allow-unverified without an operator-recorded override reason (matches using-specialists rule #15 style)
- ~/dev/core/.claude/skills/service-skills/scripts/verifier/__main__.py
  - Add --gate-mode flag that returns the gate verdict + non-zero exit code on INVALID/CONFLICT (so CI can gate cleanly)
- ~/dev/core/.github/workflows/service-skills-drift-sweep.yml
  - Run verifier BEFORE peter-evans/create-pull-request; publish manifest.json as artifact; add a status check ('service-skills-verify')
  - On INVALID/CONFLICT: fail the job (sticky comment only, no PR)
  - On INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_HIGH_RISK: open draft PR with 'do-not-merge' label
- New: docs/service-skills-verifier-gate.md documenting the lattice + operator override path

## NON_GOALS

- No changes to the PR1 verifier module itself (extend via flags, not schema changes)
- No FTS5 index integration (PR3)
- No auto-merge enable — even PASS opens a normal PR
- No changes to bead validator (PR4)
- No new hook wiring
- No security-auditor integration
- No panel/multi-LLM vote

## CONSTRAINTS

- Verifier gate must run BEFORE atomic_write in every code path (auto-reconcile + specialist + manual CLI)
- Residual critic call is bounded: max evidence bundle ≤ 4000 tokens per claim, max claims per run ≤ 12, hard cap 8000 tokens total per run (research §2.9)
- Critic timeout: 60s per claim, 300s per run; on timeout the residual stays UNKNOWN and is rendered as caveat, not blocker
- EVIDENCE_RACE detection: recompute source SHAs at start + end of verifier run; if changed → invalidate + retry once, then fail
- Draft-PR path for INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_HIGH_RISK: use 'draft: true' + 'do-not-merge' label; PR body prominently lists unverifiable claims
- The specialist path may not fall back to writing without the verifier — no override flag exists in this PR; operator override is a follow-up bead if needed
- Logging/telemetry: every gate decision emits one structured line: {timestamp, component=reconcile-gate, event=gate_decision, verdict, service_id, invalid_count, conflict_count, unknown_count, critic_calls, critic_tokens, duration_ms}. Grep 'component=reconcile-gate' finds all decisions in the audit trail.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] Unit tests for compute_gate() covering every lattice cell (INVALID/CONFLICT/EVIDENCE_RACE/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_HIGH_RISK/PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES/PASS)
- [ ] Integration test: reconcile.py invoked on api-gateway regression fixture → gate=CONFLICT → no atomic_write called (mock filesystem or tmp dir)
- [ ] Integration test: reconcile.py on a clean fixture → gate=PASS → atomic_write called exactly once with the candidate content
- [ ] EVIDENCE_RACE test: simulate source SHA change mid-run → gate returns EVIDENCE_RACE → run retries → second run completes cleanly
- [ ] service-skills-sync specialist smoke: dispatch against a synthetic bead + fixture, observe verifier invocation in the specialist log, verify no write on CONFLICT
- [ ] GHA workflow smoke via workflow_dispatch: manifest.json published as artifact, 'service-skills-verify' check appears on the PR
- [ ] Residual critic test: force UNKNOWN on one claim, mock the provider, verify the critic call is bounded (evidence tokens < 4000) and advisory-only (does not change verdict)
- [ ] Reviewer sees on the PR: candidate diff, per-claim verdict, evidence path + line range, complete-set comparison for set_claims, residuals + critic advisory
- [ ] Structured telemetry: grep 'component=reconcile-gate' in the artifact log returns one line per gate decision with correct fields

## LIBRARIES

- Reuse in repo: reconcile.py itself (extend, don't rewrite), verifier module from PR1, drift_detector.py refs helper
- Installed deps: httpx (already in reconcile.py for the LLM provider call), tenacity if retry policy is needed (verify presence before adding)
- Stdlib: hashlib for SHA re-check, tempfile for candidate path, subprocess if invoking verifier via CLI (prefer in-process import if module structure allows)
- New dep candidate: none — critic uses the same provider client reconcile.py already has
- Roll it: reuse existing tenacity if present, else stdlib retry loop with capped attempts

## OUTPUT

- Diff on reconcile.py (helper functions + gate branch)
- Diff on service-skills-sync specialist definition
- Diff on service-skills-drift-sweep.yml
- New docs/service-skills-verifier-gate.md
- pytest output (all green)
- workflow_dispatch smoke transcript (or link to a test-branch run) showing manifest.json artifact + check
- Sample PR description on a CONFLICT fixture (proves reviewer sees the residuals)
- Sample telemetry lines from a passing + failing run

## APPROACH NOTES

- Prefer in-process import of the verifier module over subprocess where possible (avoids IPC + JSON round-trip); fall back to CLI only when the CI/hook context can't import the module.
- The critic call MUST come from the same provider adapter reconcile.py already uses (nano-gpt / openrouter / etc.) — do not hard-code Anthropic or OpenAI.
- The 'don't self-merge, keep bead open, escalate to operator' pattern from the successful infra-wtd1 dispatch applies here. Both PRs (core + specialists) open, linked to xtrm-56flm.2, wait for operator merge.
- Cross-repo: specialist edit lives in ~/dev/specialists; open two PRs, link them in bead notes, ship the core PR first (verifier lives there).

## Summary

Shipped PR2 — the deterministic §2.7 gate that makes the PR1 verifier **binding** on `reconcile.py`'s write path. The reconciler now writes the candidate to a temp path first, runs the verifier in-process, computes a 6-tier lattice verdict, and only calls `atomic_write` on `PASS`/`PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES`. REVISION 3 honored: **no LLM residual critic**. Specialist parity achieved by making `gated_write()` the single unavoidable write path (no override flag, no alternate path). Worked only in `~/dev/xtrm`; did not touch retired `~/dev/core` or `~/dev/specialists`.

## Status
**success** — PR #17 open on xtrm-dev/xtrm, MERGEABLE base=main, 160 tests green. Bead `xtrm-56flm.2` left **IN_PROGRESS** (not self-closed, per session override).

## Changes
- **`verifier/gate.py`** (new): `compute_gate(manifest, evidence_race=…) -> GateDecision` — full lattice (`EVIDENCE_RACE`>`INVALID`>`CONFLICT`>`INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_HIGH_RISK`>`PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES`>`PASS`), `is_writable`/`blocks_pr`/`is_draft_pr`/`is_retryable`/`exit_code`, `corpus_fingerprint`/`source_fingerprint`.
- **`reconcile.py`**: `run_verifier()` (in-process verify + SHA race fingerprinting), `gated_write()` (verify→gate→conditional write, retry-once on EVIDENCE_RACE, `component=reconcile-gate` telemetry to `.xtrm/state/service-knowledge/events.jsonl`). Loop routes every SKILL write through it. Removed pre-existing unused `get_registry_path` import.
- **`verifier/__main__.py`**: `--gate-mode` → gate verdict (JSON `{gate,manifest}` / Markdown banner) + non-zero exit on `INVALID`/`CONFLICT`/`EVIDENCE_RACE`.
- **`verifier/__init__.py`**: export gate symbols.
- **GHA template** `packages/service-knowledge/.github/workflows/service-skills-drift-sweep.yml`: gate before `create-pull-request`, `manifest.json`+`report.md` artifact, `service-skills-verify` check, draft `do-not-merge` on high-risk.
- **Packaging fix**: ship `scripts/verifier/schema/*.json` in wheel (latent PR1 gap activated by module-level import) — verified via clean-venv wheel install.
- **Version**: v0.3.0→v0.4.0 in `pyproject.toml` + `VERSION` + `__init__.py`. **CHANGELOG** entry. **Docs** `docs/devops/service-knowledge-verifier-gate.md` + cross-link.
- **Tests**: `test_gate.py` (21) + `test_gate_integration.py` (12).

## Verification
- `pytest` full package suite: **160 passed** (vaultctl venv). Gate-only: **33 passed**.
- `api-gateway` CONFLICT → `atomic_write` never called; `runners` PASS → called exactly once with candidate content; EVIDENCE_RACE → retry → clean PASS; persistent race → fail after one retry (4 fingerprints).
- `--gate-mode`: CONFLICT exit 1, PASS exit 0, advisory-mode (no flag) still exit 0.
- Wheel build ships `manifest_schema.json`+`gate.py`; clean install runs gate end-to-end.
- Telemetry sample (PASS): `{"component":"reconcile-gate",…,"service_id":"runners","verdict":"PASS","critic_calls":0,"critic_tokens":0}`; (CONFLICT): `…,"service_id":"api-gateway","conflict_count":2,"verdict":"CONFLICT"}`.
- ruff `E9,F,W6` clean; workflow YAML + pyproject TOML parse; no trailing-ws/EOF issues.

## Risks
- **Extractor heuristics fixture-tuned** (inherited from PR1): real SKILLs with high-risk `UNKNOWN` claims may hit `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_HIGH_RISK` and refuse the write — intended blast-radius protection, but may need more `set_claim` resolvers.
- **PR #17 body is minimal** — GitHub returned HTTP 500 on rich-body GraphQL/REST creates; PR created via REST with a short body. Full detail lives in commit `316666c` + the gate doc. Orchestrator may enrich the body.
- **`workflow_dispatch` + live specialist smoke not run** — need GitHub Actions / `sp` runtime absent from this worktree; covered by design + tests + workflow template.

## Follow-ups
- Residual LLM critic (only if measured verifier FN > 0.10) — `critic_calls`/`critic_tokens` schema reserved.
- Operator override flag (rule-#15 style) if a force-write need arises — deliberately absent here.
- Enrich PR #17 body; run `workflow_dispatch` smoke on a consumer repo post-merge.

## Beads
- `xtrm-56flm.2` noted with PR URL, **left IN_PROGRESS** (not closed, per override). Parent epic `xtrm-56flm`.

DONE. PR: https://github.com/xtrm-dev/xtrm/pull/17. Bead xtrm-56flm.2 stays open pending operator merge.
